title: Optional display_name field with fallback guidance in docstring
description: UserProfile.display_name is Option<String> (lines 46), marked #[serde(default)]. The docstring (lines 37-38) explicitly documents the Headscale-without-OIDC case and specifies fallback behavior: try display_name, then login_name, then id. This is excellent API design: the type system forces callers to handle None, and the docs guide them on correct fallback logic. Keep this pattern.
